definitions.explanation: A line of ancestry or descent.

examples.japanese: この{理論|りろん}を{系統|けいとう}{的|てき}に{学|まな}ぶ。
データを{系統|けいとう}{立|だ}てて{整理|せいり}する。
{系統|けいとう}{的|てき}な{研究|けんきゅう}が{必要|ひつよう}だと{先生|せんせい}に{言|い}われた。
examples.english: My teacher told me that systematic research is needed.

examples.japanese: {生物|せいぶつ}の{系統|けいとう}{関係|かんけい}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: I am researching the phylogenetic relationships of organisms.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{武士|ぶし}の{系統|けいとう}に{属|ぞく}している。
examples.english: He belongs to a samurai lineage.

examples.japanese: この{犬種|けんしゅ}の{系統|けいとう}{図|ず}をたどると、ヨーロッパが{起源|きげん}だとわかる。
examples.english: If you trace back the genealogy of this dog breed, you can see it originated in Europe.

notes:
{系統|けいとう} refers to a system, lineage, or line of descent.

TWO MAIN MEANINGS:
1. System/order: an organized structure or methodology
2. Lineage/genealogy: a line of ancestry or descent

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {系統|けいとう}{的|てき}に: systematically
- {系統|けいとう}{図|ず}: genealogical chart, family tree; system diagram
- {系統|けいとう}{立|だ}てる: to systematize, to organize

SCIENTIFIC USAGE:
In biology, {系統|けいとう} refers to phylogenetic relationships ({系統|けいとう}{関係|かんけい}).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {系統|けいとう}: system, lineage (organized structure)
- {体系|たいけい}: system (theoretical framework)
- {血統|けっとう}: bloodline, lineage (family descent)
